issue.title: Document %queue capacity multipliers in xprompts memory
issue.description: Proposed by sase-19f.3 note #1. The approved epic plan explicitly deferred updating sase/memory/xprompts.md. Its %queue paragraph still states that capacity must be a positive integer, but %q(1.5x, w=0.25) now parses and resolves against effective max_running_agents. Update the table and paragraph with <M>x syntax, two-decimal precision, live effective-budget scaling, and the 1.5x * 5 = 7.5 example. Run sase memory init after the authorized edit. Distinct from sase-134, which documents %hold and proc queue behavior.

task_type_fields.proposed_change: Explain %q(1.5x) multiplier syntax and its effective max_running_agents resolution; replace integer-only guidance and regenerate memory output.
